All claws, antennae, tails and small effects stay INSIDE their own cell. Plenty of transparent gutters; absolutely no touching adjacent frames. Crisp readable small game sprite. Four columns: 1 anticipation/windup; 2 full charge; 3 unmistakable attack/contact pose; 4 recovery towards neutral. Large believable differences between the four poses. No victim, no other character. Any spit, dust or energy is small and close to the creature; no big disconnected projectile or long trail. Compress its slimy body under its spiral shell, raise the mouth and inflate cheeks, spit a small purple-amber sap blob forward, relax. Keep the large spiral shell, yellow head and glowing purple crystals consistent.
